blocks.content: The Lokpal shall consist of a Chairperson and a maximum of eight members, of whom fifty per cent shall be Judicial Members.

rows: Former CJI, former Supreme Court Judge, or an Eminent Person with 25+ years experience
Former Judge of Supreme Court or former Chief Justice of a High Court
Eminent person with 25+ years expertise in anti-corruption, public admin, finance, or law
Equivalent to Chief Justice of India
Equivalent to Judge of the Supreme Court
Equivalent to Judge of the Supreme Court

items: Selection Committee Composition: Prime Minister (Chairperson), Speaker of Lok Sabha, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, CJI (or nominee Judge), and an Eminent Jurist.
The salary and allowances of the Lokpal Chairperson are equivalent to the Chief Justice of India, while members receive salaries equivalent to Supreme Court Judges.
Members are ineligible for further employment under the Central or State Government after ceasing to hold office.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Lokpal is a multi-member anti-corruption ombudsman body consisting of a Chairperson and a maximum of eight members.
At least 50 per cent of the total members of Lokpal must be Judicial Members.
Minimum 50 per cent of the members must belong to SCs, STs, OBCs, Minorities, and Women.
The Chairperson and members hold office for a term of 5 years or until attaining 70 years of age.
Appointments are made by the President on the recommendation of a Selection Committee headed by the Prime Minister.
